diagnosis: The lockout UI scenario was placed after the Player restart. PairingStore detected a failed proof reservation from the prior boot and correctly applied its conservative ten-minute restart cooldown before the new session could make three proofs. This was test ordering, not a pairing or network defect.
limitation: The original runner JSON was replaced by a subsequent official run; this record preserves the report and sanitized failure details captured before replacement. The original source snapshot manifest was not archived for this failed run.
